author: Link776
quote: I was really looking forward to trying this game because I’ve played GTA 5; in essence, it’s like GTA 5 but with better graphics, though it’s also full of bugs. The game is very expensive $100 and, considering what it offered, I don’t think it was worth it. It runs at an unstable 30 fps. That said, I’ve put in 70 hours of playtime, but I don’t think it’s the best game of all time; it feels more like a product of marketing.
